Two wireless controllers are shown: one white (standard Xbox One model) and one blue (newer Xbox Series model with a central share button).
Watermark 'KINGSPLEN GAMING GADGETS' is present on all images, suggesting a professional reseller.

A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and launching.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, connected to a TV, and launching a game from a disc.
Photo of the rear of the console showing the warranty seal and the model/serial number sticker.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Xbox One S with two controllers. While functional claims are unverified, it can be priced at the base market rate for this specific model.
